implementation_steps: Implement the phone shell and exact first-fold geometry before adding secondary scenarios. Use CSS Grid for the two portrait compositions, not one polymorphic card with swapped media.
Load demo-recreate-01, demo-story-01 and demo-car-campaign-01 in the fixture's explicit ranking order. Do not reorder them after rendering to manufacture a fold.

Build a fixture-backed work detail sheet with Back, original source, terms and the permitted Apply action. Apply returns an applied record after the demo adapter response and then shows Waiting for acceptance.
Connect Save to the shared Lab store. The same saved record appears in the Activity destination preview's Saved view. Test ?mutation=fail.
Implement ?state=empty, no-matches, loading, error, external-reference, large-money and missing-city. Loading keeps controls visible and never renders sample money.
Capture the default, Story scrolled into view and Car scrolled into view at 390×844. Capture 320×568 and enlarged-text variants before approving the component system.

motion_and_interaction: Filter activation moves the selection edge over 180ms and replaces confirmed fixture results over 140ms, cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Nearby without a city opens Set your city; no GPS permission.
Kind and detail sheets enter in 320ms from at most 48px below, same ease-out; exit in 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,1,1). Close, Escape and focus return are mandatory.
Inspect reference and View work may use 280ms selected-media continuity for one image only; unsupported browsers receive a 140ms fade. Money, shell and full feed never interpolate.
Save changes only after the 250ms demo response, then uses 140ms icon/color feedback. Failure keeps the previous state and exposes Retry.

If a genuine directly playable reference is later supplied, preview once after 75% visibility for 500ms, muted and inline, for at most 6 seconds. Show a persistent 44px Pause control; stop below 50% visibility or when the tab hides. Default still fixture does not activate this behavior.
Reduced motion removes geometry changes and any automatic preview, retaining complete static compositions and all controls.
